name: @arkivo/pc-agent
description: Arkivo para PC — recebe os backups do celular e guarda numa pasta do computador.
author: Arkivo

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-renderer.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.core.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/write-build-config.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:win:teste: npm run build && node scripts/write-build-config.mjs http://localhost:3000 && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
